hardening_actions_implemented.description: Explicit blacklist added for compromised token 'cbe-staging-operator-key-2026'. Any submission returns OPERATOR_TOKEN_REVOKED.
Implemented hmac.compare_digest to prevent timing side-channel attacks on operator authorization token.
Sliding window rate-limiter: maximum 5 failed attempts within 60 seconds triggers OPERATOR_AUTH_RATE_LIMITED_LOCKOUT.
When neither CBE_OPERATOR_TOKEN nor OPERATOR_TOKEN is configured in environment, system fails closed with OPERATOR_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED.
Permanent server-side block for mutating operations when CBE_ENV=production, regardless of provided token.
Removed hardcoded password prefill in dashboard_ui.py. Operator input is blank by default.
